segments.text: Two o'clock. Team Seven, Meridian 9, against the Tarn, second four 16.
segments.instruct: Warm, restrained Australian narration. Read the written team listing precisely, including each rank. Clear factual register, no announcer excitement. Stay in the same adult narrator voice.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: She had known it would not. She had known it at the table at eleven with the chalk in Perrin's fist, and said it, and Perrin had said wrist, then, and she had said wrist. But a wrist under a pole is not a hand round it, and the head of the Commodore came over the hazel at her and she took it on her left hand and her right wrist and it went down on the right. Pru had the foot. Pru had put her capped fingers round the foot poles, because that was where the foot was. Kiva heard her draw her breath in through her teeth.
segments.instruct: Warm, restrained Australian narration. Clear tactical narration, deliberate complete thought landings. Carry the final physical observation through to its quiet end. Stay in the same adult narrator voice.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Team Seven 9 beat the Tarn, second four 16. Seven to two.
segments.instruct: Warm, restrained Australian narration. Read the written result and each team rank precisely; quiet factual delivery, no announcer excitement. Stay in the same adult narrator voice.
